name: Aquarium Tanks
description: Glass tanks that show live fish and breed baitfish.

pages.title: Aquarium Tanks
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Tank blocks that fill a **box** up to 8 on a side join into one tank.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Fill it **half** with water, then let fish in from buckets.
- Fish swim inside at their real size.
- Two baitfish of a kind, fed **Fish Meal**, breed.
Four iron sheets and four glass make 4. The tank has an open top and a sand floor; long, shallow tanks work.

**Water** comes by bucket or by pipe. Once the tank is at least half full, fish go in:

- from any mod's fish bucket
- a fish you've just caught and are holding up (it counts as kept)

An empty bucket scoops a fish back out into its bucket.

A fish needs room by its size, and a tank longer than itself. An empty hand on the tank shows its size, water, fish and food.\
\
Breaking a wall spills the fish; breaking off a whole end keeps them in what is left.

**Breeding baitfish.** Two or more of one baitfish species, fed Fish Meal (by hand, funnel or hopper), raise a young one every two minutes.\
\
The Live-Bait Bucket scoops out the spare ones; the tank keeps two of each kind. Sneak with it to let its fish into the tank.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Automatic live bait.** Hoppers and funnels feed meal in and take spare baitfish out. A funnel into a Geared Reel Drive's bait slot keeps it baited with fish from the tank.\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Moving Items](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#]().
